newsitem.title: FRANCE: Marseille 1996 air cargo traffic up three pct.
newsitem.headline: Marseille 1996 air cargo traffic up three pct.

text.p: Marseille-Provence Airport said it handled 44,163 tonnes of air cargo traffic last year, an increase of three percent on 1995.

"For the fifth successive year, Marseille has increased its annual volume of air cargo traffic and consolidated its position as France's second gateway for airfreight after the Paris airports," an airport authority official told Reuters.

Marseille's positive results for air cargo in 1996 were largely due to the development of express traffic activities, notably by French operator, Jet Services, and the introduction of full-freighter flights by Air Algerie, the official said.
Postal traffic handled at Marseille airport in 1996 totalled 20,252 tonnes, up 11.3 percent on the previous year. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
